other_conditions: Weaver must earn at least 50% of their income from handloom weaving

Weaver must be a member of State Handloom Development Corporations/Apex/Primary Handloom Weavers’ Cooperative Societies or obtain a certificate from the State Directorate of Handlooms confirming eligibility
Scholarship is limited to a maximum of two children per member and is payable only while the parent’s premium is up‑to‑date
benefits_summary: Provides life and disability insurance (₹60,000 for natural death, ₹1,50,000 for accidental death or total disability, ₹75,000 for partial disability) and a scholarship of ₹600 per six months for up to two children of the insured weaver.
documents_required: Certificate from State Directorate of Handlooms (for non‑member applicants)
Death certificate/post‑mortem report/medical certificate/discharge certificate (for claim)
